name: Menhera Ayuri no Yamanai Onedari ~Headphone wa Hazusenai~
original_name: メンヘラ歩理のヤまないおねだり ～ヘッドホンははずせない～
source:
Once upon a time, there was an idol who was all the rage but has now been forgotten by her fans.

Desperate to make a comeback, Utakata Ayuri sets about writing new songs but, try as she may, she can't make things work.

Keita Haruyama has arrived as a new manager but struggles with Ayuri's constant pushing around.

One day, Ayuri comes across a suspicious online self-help article. It claims that increasing one's sexual arousal will activate the brain. Seeing the benefit in this, Ayuri begs Keita and ends up having sex for the first time.

Ayuri soon becomes sex-crazed and begins to express her various desires to Keita, perhaps because she believes that if they have sex, she might be able to compose more songs.

translation:
从前，有一位曾经风靡一时的偶像，如今却被粉丝们遗忘了。

歌田亚由里渴望东山再起，开始创作新歌，但无论她如何努力，都无法成功。

春山庆太 (Keita Haruyama) 作为新任主教练上任，但因阿尤里 (Ayuri) 的不断推波助澜而苦苦挣扎。

有一天，阿尤里在网上发现了一篇可疑的自助文章。它声称增加性唤起会激活大脑。看到这样做的好处，阿尤里恳求凯塔，并最终进行了第一次性行为。

阿尤里很快变得性疯狂，并开始向凯塔表达她的各种欲望，也许是因为她相信，如果他们发生性关系，她也许能够创作更多歌曲。
